review:
Big Bass – Hold & Spinner adds a second bonus to the standard Big Bass formula. The 5x3 reels keep the familiar rods, floats and tackle, and the regular free spins work as usual: the fisherman collects fish values, and every four fishermen retrigger the round and raise the multiplier.

The new feature is a hold and spin round triggered by three coins in the base game. Those coins stick, you get lives that reset each time a new coin lands, and the values are added up when the lives run out. Diamond symbols can also appear and add larger prizes. Having two distinct bonuses gives the game more variety than many series entries, and the top advertised win is 10,000x. The RTP of 96.07% matches several recent Big Bass releases.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
